issues.feedback: The happy-path test assumes a child `ralph auto` run can use `standard_mock_script()`, but `auto` requires quick-PRD writer/reviewer prompt handling first. `standard_mock_script()` does not cover those prompts, so this flow will fail before planning/implementation unless you use `auto_mock_script()` or equivalent.

The proposed QA/review iteration-limit expectations do not match orchestrator behavior. Rollback removes the in-progress loop and resets planning; it does not reliably increase persisted loop count. Also, `run --loops 1` returns an error on limit hit, while `auto` (`until_complete`) can loop indefinitely if QA/review always fails.

Requirements explicitly call for backend timeout handling, but no timeout-focused test is defined. Add at least one deterministic timeout case (e.g., mock backend sleep + low timeout config) and verify terminal task state/error handling.

The spec treats fallback as 'primary backend fails', but current reformatter fallback is parse-error-driven, not generic backend execution failure/timeout fallback. Clarify intended behavior and add tests that match actual semantics (parse fallback success and non-parse failure path).

Acceptance asks for `state.json` consistency at key workflow stages, but the plan mostly validates final state. There is no mechanism described to capture intermediate phase boundaries during daemon execution.

Requirements call out implementation response formatting (timestamp prefix, YAML frontmatter, required sections). The plan validates spec/impl-notes/review-approved artifacts, but does not explicitly force and validate `*-impl-response-NNN.md` artifacts.

The acceptance criteria require documentation updates on test architecture/run instructions, but the spec says only `tests_e2e.rs` and `mod.rs` change and mentions only doc comments. Add explicit docs file updates (e.g., README/validate docs).

A mock `RALPH_DAEMON_BIN` script that internally runs `ralph auto` can recurse into itself if it resolves `ralph` from PATH. The spec should require invoking the real binary via absolute path (`h.ralph_bin`) inside the wrapper.
Happy-path PR assertions check creation/URL but not 'correct metadata' (title/body/head/base). Add explicit assertions against captured `gh pr create` arguments/body file contents.
